issues.description: signing_mode_enum free function duplicates the same logic three times — pick one home.
issues.detail: There is a module-level signing_mode_enum(request) and two property wrappers named signing_mode_enum on SignMessageByAddress and SignMessageByID that just call it. Either make it a shared helper used directly, or a mixin. Two names that resolve to the same logic is the kind of thing the next maintainer has to grep twice to confirm.

issues.description: signing_mode_enum logic has a fall-through case that is reachable only by coincidence.
issues.detail: Four boolean combos, three explicit branches, then 'return CHIP_0002' as default. The default actually corresponds to 'not is_hex and safe_mode' but a reader has to enumerate the truth table to confirm. Spell out the fourth branch explicitly — bad taste to leave the reader to prove correctness.

issues.description: verify_signature docstring still references a 'request' parameter that no longer exists.
issues.detail: Signature is now (signing_mode, public_key, message, signature, address) but the docstring says ':param request:'. Either the extraction was sloppy or it's a copy-paste artifact. Fix the docstring or delete it — stale docs are worse than no docs.

issues.description: sign_message still duplicates the mode dispatch that verify_signature also encodes.
issues.detail: The exact same mode-to-bytes mapping lives in sign_message() and verify_signature() in the new module. Extract a single _message_to_bytes(mode, message) helper. Otherwise the next CHIP mode gets added in one place and the other silently disagrees.

issues.description: convert_secret_key_to_synthetic is an instance method that uses no instance state.
issues.detail: It only calls calculate_synthetic_secret_key with a module-level constant. Making it a Wallet method just to be called from the RPC layer adds a self-binding that means nothing. A module function or staticmethod would say what it actually is.

issues.description: DID error message changed from 'Missing DID inner puzzle' / 'Invalid inner DID puzzle' to just 'Invalid DID inner puzzle' — drift.
issues.detail: The pre-extraction code distinguished the missing-inner case from the uncurry-failed case. The new current_p2_puzzle_hash collapses one of them and rewords the other. Probably harmless but it's a user-visible string change inside a pure refactor PR — flag it or restore the original wording.

review.summary: Mechanical extraction of sign_message / verify_signature into chia/wallet/util/signing.py — the right shape of patch and a good direction. The body of the code mostly moved unchanged, which is what you want in an extraction. However it stops one step short of the cleanup that motivates the extraction: the mode-to-bytes dispatch is still duplicated between sign and verify, and the new signing_mode_enum helper exists in three places with a fall-through default. Also a stale docstring referencing 'request' and a couple of minor wording drifts in error messages. NEEDS-WORK — small, fixable, then land it.
